assets.subject: Three cucumber hosomaki sushi pieces on a small cream plate with red rim. Dark nori OUTSIDE, cream rice ring and vivid green cucumber center visible on round cut faces. No fish.
Three tuna hosomaki sushi pieces on a small cream plate with red rim. Dark nori OUTSIDE, cream rice ring and deep red raw tuna center visible on round cut faces. No cucumber or salmon.
Two tamago nigiri sushi: thick golden rolled omelette slabs on small oblong cream rice mounds, each bound by one narrow dark nori strip, on a cream plate with red rim.
Two salmon nigiri sushi: orange raw salmon slices with simple pale diagonal fat lines draped over compact cream oblong rice mounds, on a cream plate with red rim. No nori wrapping.
Two golden-brown inari sushi tofu pouches filled with cream rice, one open top visibly showing rice grains. On a small cream plate with red rim. No fish or nori.

A small cream ceramic bowl with red rim of chirashi sushi: cream sushi rice visibly topped with orange salmon sashimi slices, thin golden egg ribbons and a few dark nori strips. Distinct separated colorful toppings.
A small rounded clear glass bottle of pale golden sushi vinegar with a green cap and a simple cream blossom emblem, no lettering. Light translucent liquid, distinct from dark soy sauce.
One fresh dark green cucumber angled diagonally, with two round cucumber slices showing pale green flesh and a few tiny cream seeds. No plate, no sushi.
A deep ruby-red raw tuna loin block with two thick cut slices leaning beside it, subtle darker red muscle lines. Clearly red tuna flesh, no orange salmon, no whole fish, no rice.
Two rectangular golden fried tofu sheets, one cut open to show a hollow pocket with pale interior. Soft porous golden-brown skin, no rice filling, no plate, no sushi.
A small mound of muted fresh green wasabi paste with a ridged swirl on a tiny cream ceramic dish with red rim. One short knobbly green wasabi root beside the dish. No sushi.
